economic growth: Thanks to strong exports of computer chips, Taiwan enjoyed rapid economic growth and many new jobs last year.
多虧了晶片的強勁出口，台灣去年享有快速的經濟成長，也創造了許多新工作。
the economic climate: In the current economic climate, many young people choose to save money instead of buying expensive cars.
在目前的經濟氛圍下，許多年輕人選擇存錢，而不是買昂貴的車子。
economic sanctions: Several countries placed economic sanctions on the nation, refusing to trade with it until it stopped the war.
好幾個國家對該國實施經濟制裁，拒絕與它貿易，直到它停止戰爭為止。
an economic downturn: During an economic downturn, many companies cut jobs, and families have to spend less on travel and eating out.
在經濟衰退期間，許多公司裁員，家庭也必須減少旅遊和外食的花費。
an economical car: My father wanted an economical car that uses little gas, so he could save money on his long drive to work.
我爸爸想要一輛省油的車，這樣他長途開車上班時就能省錢。
be economical with the truth: The salesman was economical with the truth; he never mentioned that the used car had been in a serious accident.
那位業務員說話避重就輕；他從未提到那輛二手車曾發生過嚴重車禍。
an economical use of space: The tiny apartment makes an economical use of space, with a bed that folds into the wall during the day.
這間小公寓對空間做了節省的利用，白天床可以折收進牆裡。
economical to run: This small electric scooter is cheap to charge and economical to run, so it is popular with college students.
這台小型電動機車充電便宜、使用成本低，所以很受大學生歡迎。
educational background: The company asked every applicant about their educational background, including which university they had graduated from.
公司詢問每位應徵者的教育背景，包括他們從哪所大學畢業。
an educational experience: Visiting the science museum was an educational experience for the children, who learned a lot about how planets move.
參觀科學博物館對孩子們來說是一次有教育意義的經歷，他們學到很多關於行星如何運行的知識。
educational toys: Many parents buy educational toys, such as building blocks and puzzles, to help their young children learn while playing.
許多家長購買益智玩具，例如積木和拼圖，幫助年幼的孩子在玩耍中學習。
an efficient system: The library uses an efficient system that lets students borrow and return books in seconds with their ID cards.
圖書館使用一套高效率的系統，讓學生用學生證幾秒內就能借還書。
energy-efficient appliances: To lower their electricity bill, the family replaced their old fridge and air conditioner with energy-efficient appliances.
為了降低電費，這家人把舊冰箱和冷氣換成了節能電器。
fuel-efficient: With gas prices rising, more drivers are choosing fuel-efficient cars that can travel farther on each liter.
隨著油價上漲，越來越多駕駛人選擇每公升能跑更遠的省油車。
a highly efficient worker: Amy is a highly efficient worker who always finishes her tasks early and rarely makes any mistakes.
艾咪是一位工作效率極高的員工，她總是提早完成任務，而且很少出錯。
an elaborate plan: The students made an elaborate plan for the surprise party, with every detail from the cake to the music carefully arranged.
學生們為驚喜派對擬定了周密詳盡的計畫，從蛋糕到音樂的每個細節都仔細安排好了。
an elaborate ceremony: The temple held an elaborate ceremony with music, dancers, and hundreds of colorful decorations to celebrate the god's birthday.
廟方舉辦了一場繁複隆重的儀式，有音樂、舞者和數百個彩色裝飾，來慶祝神明的生日。
elaborate on the proposal: The committee asked Kevin to elaborate on the proposal and explain exactly how the new club would be paid for.
委員會請凱文詳細說明該提案，並解釋新社團的經費究竟從何而來。
an elaborate excuse: Instead of admitting he forgot his homework, Tom made up an elaborate excuse about a dog, a storm, and a broken bike.
湯姆沒有承認忘了寫作業，反而編了一個關於狗、暴風雨和壞掉腳踏車的精心藉口。
an elastic band: She tied her long hair back with an elastic band before starting her basketball practice in the gym.
她在體育館開始練籃球前，用一條橡皮筋把長髮綁到後面。
an elastic timetable: Our club has an elastic timetable, so members can come in the morning or evening depending on their classes.
我們社團的時間表很有彈性，所以成員可以依照課程在早上或晚上來。
elastic demand: Movie tickets have elastic demand; when prices go up even a little, many people simply stop going to the cinema.
電影票具有彈性需求；價格只要稍微上漲，許多人就乾脆不去電影院了。
the elderly: Many volunteers visit the elderly who live alone, bringing them meals and chatting with them every weekend.
許多志工每週末探訪獨居的老年人，為他們送餐並陪他們聊天。
care for the elderly: As Taiwan's population ages, more young people are training as nurses to care for the elderly in their communities.
隨著台灣人口老化，越來越多年輕人接受護理訓練，以照顧社區裡的老人。
electronic devices: Students must turn off all electronic devices, including phones and smartwatches, before the exam begins.
考試開始前，學生必須關掉所有電子裝置，包括手機和智慧手錶。
electronic payment: Most night markets now accept electronic payment, so you can buy snacks by scanning a code with your phone.
現在大多數夜市都接受電子支付，所以你可以用手機掃碼買小吃。
electronic mail: Before phones became popular, electronic mail was the fastest way for my parents to contact friends living abroad.
在手機普及之前，電子郵件是我父母聯絡海外朋友最快的方式。
an elegant solution: Instead of building a costly new road, the engineer found an elegant solution: changing the timing of the traffic lights.
工程師沒有花大錢蓋新路，而是想到一個簡潔巧妙的解決方法：調整紅綠燈的時間。
an elegant proof: The math teacher showed us an elegant proof that used only three short, simple steps to solve the problem.
數學老師給我們看了一個精妙的證明，只用三個簡短的步驟就解決了問題。
elegant simplicity: The café is famous for its elegant simplicity, with white walls, wooden tables, and just a few green plants.
這家咖啡廳以優雅的簡約著稱，有白牆、木桌，以及寥寥幾盆綠色植物。
